title: Paper Lanterns
style: cinematic indie pop ballad, felt piano, swelling strings, deep heartbeat kick, intimate female vocal that opens up into a soaring chorus, 72 bpm
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We wrote our names on paper lanterns
Down by the river in July
You said the wind would know the answer
If we just let the fire fly
Your hand was shaking, mine was steady
At least that's how I tell it now
We watched them climb until the city
Was just a glow beneath the clouds

[Pre-Chorus]
So every summer I come back here
Strike a match and hold it near

[Chorus]
Light it up and let it go
Every word I never said out loud
Light it up and let it go
Higher than the both of us somehow
And if it finds you anyhow
Tell me you can see it from the clouds

[Verse 2]
They tore the old pier down last winter
Put up a fence and painted lines
But I still know the way by heartbeat
I find the water every time
I keep a lighter in my pocket
I keep your laugh inside my head
I fold the paper like you showed me
And write the things I should have said

[Pre-Chorus]
So every summer I come back here
Strike a match and hold it near

[Chorus]
Light it up and let it go
Every word I never said out loud
Light it up and let it go
Higher than the both of us somehow
And if it finds you anyhow
Tell me you can see it from the clouds

[Bridge]
Paper and fire, paper and fire
Nothing this light should rise so high
Paper and fire, paper and fire
Maybe that's how we say goodbye

[Final Chorus]
Light it up and let it go
Every word I never said out loud
Light it up and let it go
Higher than the both of us somehow

[Outro]
Down by the river in July

Se fue la luz en todo el barrio
Y nadie quiere irse a dormir

Alguien trae limones y café
Y la ciudad allá abajo, oscura
Nos mira bailar sin saber por qué

[Pre-Chorus]
Sube, sube, que la luna está invitando

[Chorus]

Y la verdad, a nadie le importó
